description.en:
FIRISHTA, Muham.mad Kasi.m Hindu Shah, 
known as Firishta (born 960 =: 1552, died 
after I033 = *^23), of Astarabad in northern 
Persia, was brought to Aljmadnagar as a child in 

the reign of Husain
